messages:
maya: quick design review — mobile toolbar is feeling cramped on phones. attached a gif of the current flow + a very rough alternative where primary actions collapse into a kebab menu. thoughts?

dom: looks better to me, especially on 360px wide. can we avoid a second tap for the most common action though? maybe keep primary action as a floating FAB?

maya: good call. the FAB might conflict with table overflow actions though. idea: keep primary FAB, secondary actions go into kebab.

ash: +1 on FAB for primary. also the table rows are still overflowing on smaller devices and causing horizontal scroll which hides the right-side action column. can we collapse some columns into a summary + expand row?

leila: that pattern worked for billing table — collapsed summary row with a chevron to expand. we should keep keyboard focusable expand targets and announce state to screen readers.

neal: accessibility nit: if we keep FAB, ensure touch target is >=48px and provide aria-label that explains action (e.g., "Create inference job"). a11y-bot: automated scan flagged low contrast on the toolbar divider when collapsed.

maya: thanks neal — noted for dev. quick CSS breakpoint proposal: `@media (max-width: 420px) { .console-actions { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .action-secondary { display: none; } .action-kebab { display: inline-flex; } }` open to tweak numbers.

dom: can we move from 420px-> 480px? most android devices land around 412-412, but better to be conservative. also add `overflow-x:auto` to tables as fallback but prefer collapsing columns.

ash: will prototype collapsed summary today. small copy change suggestion: instead of "Details" for the expand button, use "More" on mobile so it reads shorter.

leila: UX question — when a row is expanded should the FAB hide to avoid overlap? i'm leaning no, keep FAB visible but shift it up slightly when an expanded panel opens.

maya: agree keep FAB visible. animate translateY(-60px) on panel open to avoid overlap. add a small pointer to show relation.

neal: also add focus trap when expanded content has interactive elements; ensure esc closes it and returns focus to the row toggle.

a11y-bot: checklist suggestion: [ ] 48px touch targets, [ ] aria-expanded on toggles, [ ] focus order preserved, [ ] contrast >= 4.5:1 for text on controls.

dom: tiny copy tweak — toolbar title "Routes" reads odd on mobile, consider "Routes & models" -> "Routes" is fine if we show context pill. maybe drop extra words and show tooltip on long press.

maya: i'll update the figma to reflect FAB + kebab + collapsed table rows and try breakpoint at 480 and 360. will post prototype link shortly. thanks everyone :sparkles:

ash: test note: verify in landscape phones too — table collapse should still be accessible when width becomes ~650px.

leila: a11y test volunteers? i'll pair with neal tomorrow 10:30 PT.

maya: booked — i'll upload the prototype by EOD. :thumbsup:
